system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Your binding chains aren’t the only secret technique passed down through the Uzumaki clan. You also learn to prepare special sealing formulas known only to your clan. These formulas are places onto chakra seals, turning them into Spiral Tags. Spiral Tags are special tags that can apply to damage dealt with the Binding Chain clan feature, as part of casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu or even following its effect text.

You can use no more than one Spiral Tags per turn. You begin with 2 known Spiral Tags. You gain an additional one at 7th and 11th levels. A Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If you would use a Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw as part of a Hijutsu you cast that also forces a saving throw, you pick which saving throw to use, following both effects on a success or failure.

Bound Inscription. As part of damage dealt or a creature failing a saving throw you can affix a Spiral Tag to the affected creature for the next minute. Alternatively, as a Bonus action, you can affix it to a willing creature, object or surface, which lasts for 24 hours. While affixed, and you are within at least 1 mile of the Spiral Tag, you can sense and hear creatures within 15 feet of the affixed location, enough to target them as if you could see them. You can make Binding Chain attacks or cast Uzumaki Hijutsu, having them originate from the tags affixed location.

Barrier Reverse Technique. As part of damage dealt with an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, against a creature with ranks of Sealed, you can have the binding formula overwritten. Affected creatures with ranks of sealed must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the Sealed condition gains an additional effect for the next minute; A Sealed creature suffers a -1 penalty to their AC for every rank they have, but they lose one rank of sealed at the end of each of their turns.

Sealing Cage. As an Action, you can select one creature you can see, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw as they are enveloped by chains of binding, like a globe or orb. On a failed save, they are captured inside of the dome until the end of your next turn. While inside the globe they are under total cover, and blinded. They cannot be targeted or affected by hostile effects and cannot take hostile action. While within the dome they cannot mold chakra. By spending a Full-Turn Action, you can extend the duration until the end of your following turn. A creature trapped inside this dome can escape by spending their Action, making a Strength saving throw, shattering the dome on a success.

Draining Seals. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

Warding Seal. As a bonus action, you can mark a willing creature other than yourself, that you can see within 30 feet of you with a ward. A creature marked with this ward gains a rank of Mastery to their AC and a +1 bonus to their saving throws. While you have a creature marked in this way, this counts as concentrating on a jutsu of C-Rank.

Rebuking Seal. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force an affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, they gain a rank of Concussed on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.
